title: Kiritani Haruka — Bubbly Blue〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Sunday

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The next agency on my list is... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello, this is Kiritani.
Thank you for calling me back.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, this is about the agency referral from the other day and... Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry, even though you took the trouble to make the referral. We intend to carry on as an independent idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, no... We won't be reconsidering.... Yes, we made this decision together after discussing it amongst ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Minori has to be together with us. It's the four of us or nothing, no compromises.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you...
I appreciate the concern. Goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(They'll take us if we leave Minori out, huh...
I understand she has no experience but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It was Minori who renewed my...
No, all of our desires to become idols again.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone's only interested in our past achievements and not giving her a chance at all.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sigh... I have to go apologize and explain this to the other agencies too...
Some days later after school
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi was so much sharper than usual with her moves today! I hope I can dance as well as her one day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. To achieve that, you may want to work on strengthening your core.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be going now. Good work with practice and make sure to rest too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... H-Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ah... No, nevermind.
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, someone's calling... Probably another agency... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Hello? Haruka? Hey, it's been a while! How've you been doing?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm good, thanks. How about you?
I heard you transferred to another agency...

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Haha, I'm good too!
I'm finally all settled into my new agency.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <But we haven't spoken since ASRUN was disbanded. Anyway, I'm gonna just cut to the chase.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Haruka, you're trying to form a new idol group, right? Everyone here is talking about it and some are even saying they might want you to join.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <But! Because of budget constraints, we can only take you.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then that's...

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Oh, don't worry! I was there too and it felt more like they were messing around.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <I guess they don't get that someone trying to join as a group won't take an offer that's only for one person...>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Now, about why I really called you!
Well, it's more of a personal matter♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A personal matter?

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Yup. Tell me more about this girl your group. Not Hinomori or Momoi. You know, the other girl!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you mean Minori?

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Minori? So, what's she like?
How'd you meet?
I have so many questions...!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Nobody's shown any interest in Minori up to this point.)

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Hello? Hey, Haruka?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I was wondering where I should start.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I first met her when...

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Wow. She's pretty amazing, huh? She managed to get not just you, but Hinomori and Momoi interested in forming an idol group together.>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Yeah. She's gonna be an amazing idol.
I can see it already.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <Haha. What're you thanking me for?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, nobody's shown any interest in Minori until you asked...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're the first person that I've really talked to about her.

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<What, no way! Everybody's missing out!
Or they only care about short-term gains!>

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line: <I'm so glad I transferred to my current agency. The only problem is we're completely broke!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ex-ASRUN Member
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry. I have to get back to work.
Good luck, Haruka! I'll be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks... So much...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Good morning, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Morning! Great, you're back to your usual self now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How so?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Well, you seemed so distracted yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, she was trying to ask me something yesterday too, wasn't she? I see. She was worried about me.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori.
I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (People haven't had a chance to get to know Minori yet, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm sure people will see her potential someday. The four of us need to keep trying to make it happen.)
